build_model_multihead: build a multihead model with a backbone and task heads for supported tasks
init_model_params: initialize model parameters and state for all supported tasks using a PRNG key
size_summary_params: summarize the total number of parameters and byte size of a Haiku model
param_summary_breakdown: get a detailed breakdown of each parameter name, shape, and dtype in the model
predict_task_probs: run a JIT-compiled prediction for a task and return categorical probability outputs
